#!/usr/bin/env python
"""§8-2 服务端补丁（需管理员权限 + 重启 OpenViking 才生效）。

问题：QueueObserver._has_active_errors 用「累计 error_count > 0 且队列未空闲」
判断活跃故障。Embedding 队列常年 in_progress>=1，导致 11-02 的 2 个历史错误
让 /debug/health 与 /observer/system 永久 false（告警误报）。

修复：QueueError 自带 timestamp，只把窗口期（默认 900s）内的错误算作活跃。
改动是纯函数签名追加默认参数，向后兼容；原始文件先备份为 .bak-<timestamp>。
"""
import datetime
import pathlib
import shutil
import sys

TARGET = pathlib.Path(
    r"C:\Program Files\Python310\Lib\site-packages\openviking\storage\observers\queue_observer.py"
)

OLD = """    @staticmethod
    def _has_active_errors(statuses: Dict[str, QueueStatus]) -> bool:
        return any(
            status.error_count > 0 and not status.is_complete for status in statuses.values()
        )
"""

NEW = """    @staticmethod
    def _has_active_errors(
        statuses: Dict[str, QueueStatus], window_seconds: int = 900
    ) -> bool:
        \"\"\"Count only recent errors as active.

        The upstream implementation treats the cumulative error_count of any
        non-idle queue as an active failure, so a historical embedding error
        keeps /debug/health false forever. QueueError records a timestamp;
        age old errors out so the flag reflects current failures only.
        \"\"\"
        from datetime import datetime, timedelta

        cutoff = datetime.now() - timedelta(seconds=window_seconds)
        return any(
            status.error_count > 0
            and not status.is_complete
            and any(e.timestamp > cutoff for e in status.errors)
            for status in statuses.values()
        )
"""


def main() -> int:
    if not TARGET.exists():
        print(f"[ERROR] target not found: {TARGET}")
        return 1
    text = TARGET.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if OLD not in text:
        print("[ERROR] expected source block not found; file changed or patch already applied")
        return 1
    if "_has_active_errors(\n        statuses" in text:
        print("[ERROR] patch appears to be already applied")
        return 1
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    backup = TARGET.with_suffix(TARGET.suffix + f".bak-{stamp}")
    shutil.copy2(TARGET, backup)
    TARGET.write_text(text.replace(OLD, NEW, 1), encoding="utf-8")
    check = TARGET.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert OLD not in check and "window_seconds" in check, "verify failed"
    print(f"[OK] patched: {TARGET}")
    print(f"[OK] backup : {backup}")
    print("[NOTE] restart OpenViking (1933) for the change to take effect;")
    print("       restart also clears the in-memory cumulative error counters.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
